messages:
From: Helena Sørensen <helena@scandimetrics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-21T08:14:00Z
Subject: Clarifying VAT treatment for our resold orders (OSS vs reverse-charge)

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for taking this — quick background: ScandiMetrics resells a subset of our SaaS subscriptions to end-customers across the EU. Historically we've handled VAT on our side, but some of our larger B2B customers have been asking us to zero-rate via reverse-charge. At the same time, we have a small number of consumer purchases and marketplace-sold items where OSS applies.

Can you confirm which path Redwood needs from us to:
- allow invoices to be issued net (reverse-charge) for B2B accounts,
- keep OSS-treated sales correct (if we are the seller on record), and
- enable you to process payment collection to your EU bank without tax rework?

Attached are our current VAT certs and a spreadsheet mapping a sample of orders (attached: scandimetrics_vat_evidence.zip). We're trying to avoid payment holds — what do you need from our side to validate VAT IDs quickly?

Best,
Helena
Head of Partnerships
ScandiMetrics A/S
(attachments: scandimetrics_vat_evidence.zip)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Helena Sørensen <helena@scandimetrics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-21T10:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Clarifying VAT treatment for our resold orders (OSS vs reverse-charge)

Hi Helena — thanks for the context and the attachments. Short answer: we can support both paths but need a small evidence set plus a billing routing decision from you. Proposed next steps: 

1) VAT ID validation (for reverse-charge):
   - We need each B2B customer's valid EU VAT number (VIES-passable) and a signed reseller declaration confirming business-to-business status for the listed invoices.
   - If you can provide a CSV of customer name, country, VAT ID, and invoice IDs we will run an automated VIES check and flag any failures.

2) OSS vs Redwood as seller of record: 
   - If ScandiMetrics treats Redwood as the marketplace/fulfiller on specific SKUs, please indicate which SKUs and provide proof that you are applying OSS (we'll need the OSS registration number and a sample OSS report). Otherwise, OSS will not be assumed.

3) Payment collection & routing: 
   - Option A (preferred for speed): Redwood reissues EU invoices through our Luxembourg entity and accepts your wire/SEPA payment to that entity. We'll mark invoices as 'net' only after VAT ID verification succeeds.
   - Option B: You collect on your side and remit to us via Stripe/PSP — if you choose this, include the PSP settlement mapping so we can reconcile.

4) Temporary hold policy: If VAT IDs are missing or fail VIES, we will place the invoice in 'collection review' and pause automated reminders until evidence is provided. We can accept an interim payment plan if you expect a small delay.

Can you confirm which payment routing option you prefer and upload the CSV of B2B customer VAT IDs? Once we have that, Ben from finance and I will triage the sample orders you sent.

I'll also loop in Ben so he can outline any reissue steps.

Thanks,
Hannah
Head of Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
(attachments referenced: invoice_20261001-scandimetrics.pdf)

Helena / Hannah — looping in finance ops here. A couple of practical notes from our side: 

- If ScandiMetrics wants invoices reissued net (reverse-charge), we will require per-invoice proof of the buyer's VAT ID (VIES check) and an email trace showing the corporate buyer (name + postal address). We can then generate a corrected invoice with a reverse-charge annotation and zero VAT.

- For OSS-treated SKUs where ScandiMetrics is the seller: please provide your OSS registration number and one quarter's report (or a signed attestation). Without that we must collect VAT and remit accordingly.

- Payment routing: our preference is Option A (Luxembourg entity). Attached is a short checklist and the wire instructions for LU billing. If you need us to accept payment via your PSP mapping (Option B), we will need the settlement IDs and expected gross/net splits; reconciliation will take two additional business days.

Checklist (attachments included):
* ScandiMetrics evidence spreadsheet (you already supplied)
* Signed reseller declaration template (attached)
* Wire instructions LU entity (attached)

If you'd like, we can hold the two disputed invoices from Oct 1 and Oct 7 in 'pending validation' and reissue after we receive the CSV + signed reseller declaration. Please confirm which invoices to hold or to process now.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
